headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]

{"code": "# DocSLM xlsx create — openpyxl (finance)
import json
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "33544A"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Orbit CRM", 160, 170], ["Marketing", 371, 98], ["Nimbus Storage", 152, 116], ["Finance", 531, 182], ["Vertex Payroll", 281, 251], ["Sales", 348, 189]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Missing!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)
for col in ("A", "B"):
    cell = summary[f"{col}1"]
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000051_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000051_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))
"}

import json
from openpyxl import Workbok
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "1F4E79"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Orbit CRM", 464, 361], ["Marketing", 468, 262], ["Orbit CRM", 170, 132], ["Sales", 172, 95], ["Nimbus Storage", 596, 303], ["Operations", 175, 207]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()

chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Data!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)

In one sentence: **don't make boring slides.** Bullet points on a white background are forgettable.

import json
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "7B3B00"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Pulse Dashboard", 304, 244], ["Operations", 208, 230], ["Pulse Dashboard", 188, 221], ["Marketing", 359, 62], ["Orbit CRM", 326, 226], ["People Ops", 589, 272]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Data!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)
for col in ("A", "B"):
    cell = summary[f"{col}1"]
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000111_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000111_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))

import json
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "7B3B00"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Vertex Payroll", 524, 300], ["Operations", 169, 57], ["Pulse Dashboard", 451, 131], ["Finance", 443, 97], ["Pulse Dashboard", 179, 306], ["People Ops", 348, 296], ["Nimbus Storage", 375, 90], ["Marketing", 481, 335]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Data!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)
for col in ("A", "B"):

    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000113_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000113_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))

# DocSLM pdf extract_table — via the skill's pdf.py CLI
import json, subprocess, sys

TOOL = "/skills/pdf/scripts/pdf.py"
def run(args):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, TOOL] + args,
                          capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)

def _json_of(proc):
    s = proc.stdout
    return json.loads(s[s.find("{"):s.rfind("}") + 1]) if "{" in s else {}

proc = run(["extract.table", "task_000133_src.pdf"])
data = _json_of(proc)
assert data.get("status") == "success", proc.stdout[-200:]
assert data["data"]["total_tables"] >= 1, "no tables detected"
assert "Orbit CRM" in json.dumps(data), "table row not extracted"
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000133_src.pdf", "route": "extract_table"}))
"}

import json
from openpyxl import Workbok
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "33544A"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Pulse Dashboard", 409, 375], ["Finance", 256, 121], ["Nimbus Storage", 402, 128], ["Sales", 134, 302], ["Pulse Dashboard", 450, 373], ["Sales", 99, 174]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Data!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)
for col in ("A", "B"):
    cell = summary[f"{col}1"]
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000171_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000171_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))
"}

In one sentence: **don't make boring slides.** Bullet points on a white background are forgettable.

But "not boring" is not "flashy." The goal is a deck that looks **ready to use in real life** — the kind you could drop into a real meeting, class, or client pitch without editing.

**Substance comes before styling:** every slide must carry one specific, concrete claim — real numbers, names and mechanisms, and the "so what" behind them — not a topic label or generic filler. {"code": "# DocSLM xlsx create — openpyxl (analyze)
import json
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "33544A"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Nimbus Storage", 109, 175], ["Engineering", 310, 295], ["Orbit CRM", 394, 255], ["Sales", 299, 137], ["Orbit CRM", 179, 346], ["Marketing", 494, 177]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Data!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)
for col in ("A", "B"):
    cell = summary[f"{col}1"]
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000201_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000201_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))
"}

{"code": "# DocSLM xlsx create — openpyxl (finance)
import json
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "1F4E79"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Pulse Dashboard", 250, 250], ["Sales", 591, 162], ["Vertex Payroll", 124, 173], ["Operations", 558, 56], ["Orbit CRM", 458, 50], ["Engineering", 365, 242]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Missing!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)
for col in ("A", "B"):
    cell = summary[f"{col}1"]
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000261_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000261_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))
"}

import json
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Nimbus Storage", 257, 296], ["Finance", 431, 168], ["Vertex Payroll", 145, 139], ["Finance", 553, 62], ["Orbit CRM", 578, 204], ["Operations", 312, 74], ["Nimbus Storage", 477, 362], ["People Ops", 475, 70]]

    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()

chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)

    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000293_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000293_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))

{"code": "# DocSLM xlsx create — openpyxl (finance)
import json
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "7B3B00"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Pulse Dashboard", 575, 108], ["Sales", 266, 358], ["Vertex Payroll", 426, 204], ["Marketing", 557, 218], ["Orbit CRM", 346, 327], ["Engineering", 459, 127]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Missing!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)
for col in ("A", "B"):
    cell = summary[f"{col}1"]
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000321_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000321_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))
"}

import json

from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Vertex Payroll", 548, 298], ["Operations", 229, 256], ["Nimbus Storage", 310, 206], ["Marketing", 427, 262], ["Orbit CRM", 586, 216], ["Sales", 329, 266]]

    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):

{"code": "# DocSLM xlsx create — openpyxl (general)
import json
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "33544A"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Orbit CRM", 82, 111], ["Engineering", 537, 192], ["Orbit CRM", 120, 82], ["Operations", 443, 330], ["Vertex Payroll", 137, 93], ["Operations", 504, 77]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Data!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)
for col in ("A", "B"):
    cell = summary[f"{col}1"]
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000381_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000381_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))
"}

import json
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "33544A"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Orbit CRM", 494, 193], ["Sales", 536, 231], ["Vertex Payroll", 127, 318], ["Operations", 298, 397], ["Nimbus Storage", 310, 106], ["Finance", 105, 187]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Missing!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)
for col in ("A", "B"):
    cell = summary[f"{col}1"]
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000411_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000411_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))

In one sentence: **don't make boring slides.** Bullet points on a white background are forgettable.

import json
from openpyxl import Workbok
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment

    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)

{"code": "# DocSLM xlsx create — openpyxl (analyze)
import json
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "1F4E79"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Vertex Payroll", 468, 292], ["Sales", 455, 154], ["Vertex Payroll", 347, 126], ["Finance", 355, 240], ["Nimbus Storage", 563, 77], ["Engineering", 158, 207]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Missing!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)
for col in ("A", "B"):
    cell = summary[f"{col}1"]
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000471_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000471_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))
"}

import json
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "5B2C6F"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Nimbus Storage", 204, 227], ["Operations", 465, 127], ["Vertex Payroll", 380, 335], ["People Ops", 238, 256], ["Vertex Payroll", 92, 263], ["Sales", 137, 324]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Data!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)

import json
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Pulse Dashboard", 248, 386], ["Engineering", 80, 374], ["Nimbus Storage", 541, 220], ["Sales", 170, 371], ["Nimbus Storage", 189, 252], ["Marketing", 527, 350]]
for r in rows:

    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])

# Part 1 · Slide Design Best Practices

In one sentence: **don't make boring slides.** Bullet points on a white background are forgettable.

But "not boring" is not "flashy." The goal is a deck that looks **ready to use in real life** — the kind you could drop into a real meeting, class, or client pitch without editing.

**Substance comes before styling:** every slide must carry one specific, concrete claim — real numbers, names and mechanisms, and the "so what" behind them — not a topic label or generic filler. Depth is not density: it comes from picking the sharpest fact and cutting the rest, never from more text.

## 1. Decide three things before you start

**① Pick a content-informed col

### pptxgenjs rules
- defineLayout 13.33x7.5 (16:9) and set pptx.layout before adding slides.
- Title bar on every slide; body text boxes keep 0.5in margins; font sizes 12-40pt.
- Tables: explicit colW summing to box width; header row filled with theme color.
- Charts via pptx.ChartType with x/y/w/h set; colors from one theme palette.
### Tooling hint

import json
from openpyxl import Workbok
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "33544A"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Vertex Payroll", 413, 158], ["Marketing", 212, 259], ["Vertex Payroll", 590, 191], ["Engineering", 402, 318], ["Nimbus Storage", 278, 274], ["People Ops", 575, 166]]

    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row

ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row

    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000561_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000561_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))
"}

{"code": "# DocSLM xlsx create — openpyxl (finance)
import json
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "5B2C6F"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Vertex Payroll", 355, 343], ["Marketing", 228, 148], ["Vertex Payroll", 261, 201], ["Finance", 488, 206], ["Nimbus Storage", 311, 291], ["Finance", 119, 74]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Data!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)
for col in ("A", "B"):
    cell = summary[f"{col}1"]
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000591_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000591_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))
"}

import json
from openpyxl import Workbok
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "5B2C6F"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Vertex Payroll", 241, 260], ["Marketing", 503, 362], ["Orbit CRM", 556, 364], ["Sales", 508, 319], ["Vertex Payroll", 204, 287], ["Sales", 507, 156], ["Vertex Payroll", 216, 139], ["Marketing", 127, 225]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Data!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)
for col in ("A", "B"):
    cell = summary[f"{col}1"]
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000593_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000593_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))
"}

# Scene: Copywriting / Script

## Scope

Broadcast scripts, product promotion copy, livestream scripts, presentation scripts, speeches, hosting scripts, short video scripts — any document where the goal is **spoken delivery**.

→ Placeholder convention & universal prohibitions — see `references/common-rules.md`

## 1. Core Principles

⚠️ **A broadcast script is NOT a report, NOT a spec sheet, NOT an encyclopedia.**

The goal is for the audience to **understand on first listen, remember key points, and take action.** Therefore:

1. **Highlight selling points, don't pile specs:** Each paragraph covers only 1–2 core points with relatable scenario descriptions
2. **Conversational tone:** Use "you" not "the user"; use natural speech, not corporate jargon

import json
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "1F4E79"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Vertex Payroll", 594, 70], ["Engineering", 518, 191], ["Vertex Payroll", 193, 276], ["Sales", 468, 254], ["Orbit CRM", 552, 294], ["Engineering", 541, 176]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Missing!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)
for col in ("A", "B"):
    cell = summary[f"{col}1"]
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000651_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000651_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))
"}

{"code": "# DocSLM xlsx create — openpyxl (finance)
import json
from openpyxl import Workbok
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "33544A"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Vertex Payroll", 582, 294], ["Operations", 390, 350], ["Vertex Payroll", 441, 199], ["Operations", 213, 307], ["Orbit CRM", 101, 144], ["Marketing", 97, 184], ["Orbit CRM", 552, 295], ["Marketing", 259, 327]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Data!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)
for col in ("A", "B"):
    cell = summary[f"{col}1"]
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000653_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000653_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))
"}

# Part 1 · Slide Design Best Practices

In one sentence: **don't make boring slides.** Bullet points on a white background are forgettable.

But "not boring" is not "flashy." The goal is a deck that looks **ready to use in real life** — the kind you could drop into a real meeting, class, or client pitch without editing.

**Substance comes before styling:** every slide must carry one specific, concrete claim — real numbers, names and mechanisms, and the "so what" behind them — not a topic label or generic filler. Depth is not density: it comes from picking the sharpest fact and cutting the rest, never from more text.

- defineLayout 13.33x7.5 (16:9) and set pptx.layout before adding slides.

{"code": "# DocSLM xlsx create — openpyxl (general)
import json
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "33544A"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Pulse Dashboard", 365, 131], ["Marketing", 435, 249], ["Orbit CRM", 494, 296], ["Operations", 324, 90], ["Vertex Payroll", 113, 136], ["Operations", 176, 312]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Missing!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)
for col in ("A", "B"):
    cell = summary[f"{col}1"]
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000681_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000681_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))
"}

{"code": "# DocSLM xlsx create — openpyxl (finance)
import json
from openpyxl import Workbok
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "7B3B00"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Pulse Dashboard", 588, 146], ["Sales", 494, 170], ["Vertex Payroll", 94, 359], ["Engineering", 185, 384], ["Nimbus Storage", 519, 318], ["Finance", 327, 215], ["Pulse Dashboard", 183, 225], ["Engineering", 511, 245]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Data!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)
for col in ("A", "B"):
    cell = summary[f"{col}1"]
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000683_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000683_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))
"}

In one sentence: **don't make boring slides.** Bullet points on a white background are forgettable.

But "not boring" is not "flashy." The goal is a deck that looks **ready to use in real life** — the kind you could drop into a real meeting, class, or client pitch without editing.

**Substance comes before styling:** every slide must carry one specific, concrete claim — real numbers, names and mechanisms, and the "so what" behind them — not a topic label or generic filler. Depth is not density: it comes from picking the sharpest fact and cutting the rest, never from more text.

headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Orbit CRM", 230, 242], ["Operations", 329, 168], ["Pulse Dashboard", 501, 164], ["Marketing", 170, 345], ["Vertex Payroll", 214, 311], ["Marketing", 510, 192]]

    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")

    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:

ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):

data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)

    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000711_wb.xlsx")

import json
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "33544A"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Orbit CRM", 87, 152], ["People Ops", 94, 123], ["Orbit CRM", 255, 87], ["Marketing", 277, 384], ["Pulse Dashboard", 543, 138], ["Sales", 92, 307]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16

In one sentence: **don't make boring slides.** Bullet points on a white background are forgettable.

But "not boring" is not "flashy." The goal is a deck that looks **ready to use in real life** — the kind you could drop into a real meeting, class, or client pitch without editing.

Depth is not density: it comes from picking the sharpest fact and cutting the rest, never from more text.

# Part 1 · Slide Design Best Practices

In one sentence: **don't make boring slides.** Bullet points on a white background are forgettable.

But "not boring" is not "flashy." The goal is a deck that looks **ready to use in real life** — the kind you could drop into a real meeting, class, or client pitch without editing.

**Substance comes before styling:** every slide must carry one specific, concrete claim — real numbers, names and mechanisms, and the "so what" behind them — not a topic label or generic filler. Depth is not density: it comes from picking the sharpest fact and cutting the rest, never from more text.

ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])

    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20

{"code": "# DocSLM xlsx create — openpyxl (general)
import json
from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference

PRIMARY = "5B2C6F"

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Item", "Revenue (k)", "Cost (k)", "Margin (k)"]
ws.append(headers)
rows = [["Nimbus Storage", 558, 363], ["Finance", 582, 334], ["Orbit CRM", 560, 171], ["People Ops", 117, 217], ["Orbit CRM", 173, 334], ["Operations", 509, 235]]
for r in rows:
    ws.append(r)
last = ws.max_row
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, min_col=4, max_col=4):
    row[0].value = "=ROUND(B{0}-C{0},1)".format(row[0].row)
ws.append(["Total", "=SUM(B2:B{0})".format(last), "=SUM(C2:C{0})".format(last), "=ROUND(B{1}-C{1},1)".format(last, last + 1)])
total_row = ws.max_row
for c in ws[1]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for c in ws[total_row]:
    c.font = Font(bold=True)
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for i, w in enumerate([22, 14, 14, 14], start=1):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + i)].width = w

chart = BarChart()
chart.title = "Revenue vs Cost"
chart.y_axis.title = "k USD"
chart.height, chart.width = 8, 16
data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=1, max_row=last)
cats = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
ws.add_chart(chart, "F2")

summary = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
summary["A1"] = "KPI"
summary["A2"], summary["B2"] = "Total revenue", "=SUM(Data!B2:B{0})".format(last)
summary["A3"], summary["B3"] = "Total cost", "=SUM(Data!C2:C{0})".format(last)
summary["A4"], summary["B4"] = "Total margin", "=ROUND(SUM(Data!B2:B{0})-SUM(Data!C2:C{0}),1)".format(last)
for col in ("A", "B"):
    cell = summary[f"{col}1"]
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor=PRIMARY)
summary.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
summary.column_dimensions["B"].width = 16

wb.save("task_000921_wb.xlsx")
print(json.dumps({"exit": 0, "artifact": "task_000921_wb.xlsx", "sheets": 2}))
"}

# Part 1 · Slide Design Best Practices

In one sentence: **don't make boring slides.** Bullet points on a white background are forgettable.

But "not boring" is not "flashy." The goal is a deck that looks **ready to use in real life** — the kind you could drop into a real meeting, class, or client pitch without editing.

**Substance comes before styling:** every slide must carry one specific, concrete claim — real numbers, names and mechanisms, and the "so what" behind them — not a topic label or generic filler. Depth is not density: it comes from picking the sharpest fact and cutting the rest, never from more text.
